entries.description: Created docs/planning/notes-driven-supported-library-surface.md to translate the audit decision ledger and coverage gate into explicit supported-surface definitions for grid/filter/query, combo/detail/popup, shell/dashboard/catalog, reports, and security UI.

Established dedicated contract-test homes under tests/Dabbler.Components.Tests and tests/Dabbler.Reports.Blazor.Tests, added baseline smoke tests and READMEs, and added both projects to Dabbler.Platform.sln.

Updated src/Libs/README.md plus the Dabbler.Components and Dabbler.Reports.Blazor READMEs so they lead with the retained notes-driven contract and describe non-core or retirement-candidate surfaces accordingly.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully after fixing the initial smoke-test harness issues; the new Dabbler.Components and Dabbler.Reports.Blazor contract-test homes both passed their baseline tests alongside the existing suite.
Sent the Session 1 spec excerpt, changed-file contents, and successful build/test summary to the external session verifier and saved the raw review output.
Ran a second external verification round with stricter ASCII verdict formatting so the verification result is machine-readable without altering the raw first-round review.

De-emphasized non-core DabblerDataGrid advanced members for grouping, detail rows, pinning, popup forms, clipboard helpers, and CSV export via EditorBrowsable(Never) so the retained core grid workflow leads the public surface.
De-emphasized DabblerFilterGrid quick-filter, expression-line, column-toggle, and preset import/export members so the supported QBE contract leads the primary filter surface.

Changed DabblerQueryPage advanced CSV and copy helpers to opt-in defaults, hid related metadata/programmatic helpers from the primary API story, and updated the Dabbler.Components README to show the retained core query/list composition path.

Added direct Dabbler.Components contract tests and bUnit setup helpers covering the DabblerDataGrid accessible wrapper, DabblerFilterGrid AND/OR summary behavior, and DabblerQueryPage manual-search workflow with advanced actions hidden by default.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln, dotnet test tests/Dabbler.Components.Tests/Dabbler.Components.Tests.csproj, and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully; existing unrelated Dabbler.Security XML-documentation warnings remained.
Sent the Session 2 spec excerpt, changed-file contents, and successful build/test summary to the external session verifier and saved the raw review output.

Simplified the combo contract by removing add-new and grouping APIs from DabblerComboBox and DabblerMultiComboBox, retaining DabblerMultiComboBox as the current multiselect surface, and updating supported-surface docs to match the narrowed notes-driven lookup story.

Confirmed DabblerDetailForm and DabblerRecordPopup remain the retained form/popup contract, left their runtime behavior intact, and added direct contract coverage for dirty tracking and popup close behavior in the dedicated Dabbler.Components test home.

Marked DabblerQueryReportPage<T> and its PageViewMode helper as compatibility-only, updated report-facing documentation to steer callers toward DabblerReportPage, and kept the retained report prompting/execution/viewing contract centered on DabblerReportPage.

Added Session 3 contract tests covering combo surface shape and retained multiselect chips, detail-form dirty tracking, popup close behavior, DabblerReportPage auto-run composition, and the compatibility-only guard for DabblerQueryReportPage<T>.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully; the first parallel build/test attempt hit a transient Dabbler.Security obj-file lock, but the required sequential rerun passed cleanly. Existing Dabbler.Security XML-documentation warnings remained unchanged.

Sent the Session 3 spec excerpt, changed-file contents, and successful build/test summary to the external session verifier and saved the raw review output. The verifier returned VERIFIED with minor notes only.

Made DabblerShell's optional top-menu compatibility path explicit, updated the supported-surface planning doc to keep left-nav/workspace composition as the core shell story, and used a routed analysis pass to choose the narrowest safe isolation strategy before editing the shell/dashboard/catalog surfaces.

Narrowed DabblerDashboardPage around the retained landing-page core by rendering compatibility placeholders when favorites or recent-items widgets are configured without usage tracking, and marked the underlying favorites/recent-items components as hidden from the primary IntelliSense surface.

Marked DabblerCatalogPage as a compatibility-only retirement candidate, suppressed internal shell warnings for the transitional catalog path, and updated Dabbler.Components guidance so broad catalog browsing and top-menu usage-tracking flows are documented as non-core defaults.

Updated Dabbler.Security.Blazor guidance so the supported core now clearly leads with runtime authorization, secured rendering, role-aware navigation, and the security dashboard/admin surfaces, while MFA and external-login breadth are described as product/policy-shaped rather than the primary reusable contract.

Added direct Dabbler.Components contract tests for shell rendering with and without catalog providers, dashboard core widgets without usage tracking, compatibility placeholders for non-core dashboard widgets, and the catalog-page compatibility marker; security validation remained in the existing dedicated security suites and still passed in the full solution test run.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln, dotnet test tests/Dabbler.Components.Tests/Dabbler.Components.Tests.csproj, and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully. The only remaining warnings were the pre-existing Dabbler.Security XML-documentation warnings plus the SDK preview notice.

Sent the Session 4 spec excerpt, changed-file contents, and successful build/test summary to the external session verifier and saved the raw review output. The verifier returned VERIFIED with minor notes only.
